meta.title: Refactor QZydis instance in Bridge class
meta.body_summary: Make QZydis a member of Bridge to optimize GuiGetDisassembly performance and ensure configuration synchronization.

perf_labels.notes: Tiny refactor to reuse QZydis instance; bot flagged race condition but maintainer merged without addressing; no performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 23 changed lines across 2 files, this is a very small edit by absolute volume. It fits a tiny, low-risk performance refactor that was merged without human review, typical for such trivial changes.

review_details.concern_detail: cursor[bot] reported a race condition between DisassembleAt() calls via GUI_GET_DISASSEMBLY and UpdateConfig/UpdateArchitecture from configUpdatedSlot using the shared mDisasm instance without synchronization.
review_details.performance_claim: Optimize GuiGetDisassembly performance by reusing a member QZydis instance and ensure configuration synchronization.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Simple C++ member refactor for performance; the agent missed a potential concurrency issue, but maintainer merged anyway. Illustrates Cursor's ability to make small optimizations but may overlook thread safety.

detection_detail.code_reading: No human review text; bot performed static analysis and flagged race condition.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after metrics provided; narrative claim only.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Bot flagged a race condition, but maintainer merged without discussion or fix; the race condition warning was ignored.

core_change_summary.description: In Bridge.cpp, changed GuiGetDisassembly to use a member mDisasm QZydis instance instead of creating a local temporary instance each call, added configuration synchronization in configUpdatedSlot, and added mDisasm to Bridge.h header.
change_trajectory: Single commit: moved QZydis from local to member, updated configUpdateSlot to update the shared instance.

review_signals.summary: Reported a race condition due to shared mDisasm instance being used without synchronization between DisassembleAt and UpdateConfig calls.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with single commit by Cursor Agent.
cursor[bot] posted a review pointing out a race condition ~4 minutes after creation.
Maintainer mrexodia merged ~10 days later with no further comments or commits.
